# `/verified-from-addresses` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /verified-from-addresses/v1

`listFromAddressesV1` — List from addresses

Retrieve a list of sender email addresses and their verification statuses

- Scopes: idn:notification-templates:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: email: eq, ge, le, gt, lt — e.g. `email eq "john.doe@company.com"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: email — e.g. `email`
- Returns 200: array of emailstatusdto

### POST /verified-from-addresses/v1

`createVerifiedFromAddressV1` — Create verified from address

Create a new sender email address and initiate verification process.

- Scopes: idn:notification-templates:create
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): emailstatusdto
- Returns 201: emailstatusdto

### DELETE /verified-from-addresses/v1/{id}

`deleteVerifiedFromAddressV1` — Delete verified from address

Delete a verified sender email address

- Scopes: idn:notification-templates:delete
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Unique identifier of the verified sender address to delete.
- Returns 204: no body
